theorem.composite_corollary: q_plus(k,c) and q_minus(k,c) are nondecreasing in k, so worst compliant FP is k=8 and worst forbidden detection is k=k1
theorem.constant_attainment: concrete masks attaining both action-interval endpoints exist and may be reused at every time
theorem.full_history_claim: for every rational coordinatewise-monotone phi on {0,1}^m, max causal value equals iid Bernoulli(q_plus) expectation and min causal value equals iid Bernoulli(q_minus) expectation
theorem.minimality_transfer: constant endpoint masks provide the simple-binomial lower bound; bound v0.3 exact size and predecessor NP certificates provide the upper-tail optimum and infeasible predecessor
theorem.randomized_policy: private-randomized policies are convex mixtures of deterministic conditional actions and cannot exceed exact endpoint extrema
